subject: food-technology
title: Personal Hygiene
welcome_lead: Clean hands, tied hair, clean apron.
meta_desc: KS3 food: hand washing, hair, apron, jewellery rules.
final_note: Personal hygiene stops germs reaching food.

concepts.def: Tiny germs — some make us ill.
Soap + water for at least 20 seconds.
Cover that protects clothes from food.
Mesh covering to keep hair off food.

walkthroughs.body_html: Wet, soap, scrub between fingers and under nails for at least 20 seconds, rinse, dry on clean towel. Wash again after raw meat, sneezing, the toilet, touching bins.
Tie back long hair and wear a hair net if asked. Remove rings, watches. Wear a clean apron to stop clothes contaminating food.
If you have a cold, cough, cuts on hands, or stomach upset — tell the teacher. You may need to stay out of the kitchen to avoid spreading bacteria.
